connector.name: Leclerc Drive
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for E.Leclerc Drive - search products, manage cart, and order groceries from Claude
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-leclerc-drive. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the skunkobi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: LECLERC_STORE_ID
env.description: Leclerc Drive store id, e.g. 053701 (defaults to 053701).

env.name: LECLERC_HOST
env.description: Backend host for your store, e.g. fd9-courses.leclercdrive.fr (the fdN prefix varies by region).

env.name: LECLERC_COOKIE
env.description: Optional raw Cookie header override for headless hosts; by default the session is read from your local Chrome profile.

env.name: LECLERC_CHROME_PROFILE
env.description: Chrome profile directory to read the session cookie from (defaults to "Default").
